findings_qualitative.value: Dust emission is offset from UV clumps, sitting at the saddle between two UV clumps; morphology resembles a merger or chain galaxy

evidence.quote: The submillimeter emission sits at the ‘saddle’ between two clumps of bright UV emission

claims.hypothesis: Does the LBG follow the local MHC99 IRX-beta relation?
claims.experiment: ALMA 870um detection and SED-derived IRX and beta
claims.finding: Galaxy lies a factor ~10 below the MHC99 relation

evidence.quote: This puts the galaxy a factor of _⇠_ 10 below the IRX- _β_ relation for local starburst nuclei of Meurer et al. (1999).

claims.hypothesis: Does IRX vary within a single high-z galaxy?
claims.experiment: Resolved IRX map from ALMA and HST at ALMA resolution
claims.result: IRX varies by more than a factor of 3
claims.finding: Complex dust/UV morphology drives much of the IRX-beta scatter

evidence.quote: However, IRX varies by more than a factor of 3 across the galaxy

limitations_admitted.value: No resolved beta map; beta from seeing-limited photometry

limitations_admitted.value: Insensitive to dust extended beyond ~500 mas beam

Dust temperature fixed from a single FIR photometric point
